title: clove version envelope
description: The `clove version --format json` response: build/schema identity.

source.description: Where to get the source of this build (AGPL-3.0 section 13): the CLOVE_SOURCE_URL it was built with, or the upstream tree of its version tag.

_meta.description: Envelope metadata. `warnings` is the only key this response carries; `additionalProperties` is false so a new key has to be described here rather than shipping invisible to a client generated from this schema.
